equipment.name: 轻云出月
equipment.bonus: 2件套：冷凝伤害提高10%。5件套：施放技能时，冷凝伤害提高15%，持续10秒。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: Glacio DMG +10%. 5-piece: Glacio DMG increased by 15% for 10s after using Skill.
equipment.description: 冷凝系角色首选套装，适合副C和主C。
equipment.descriptionEn: Best-in-slot for Glacio characters, suitable for both main and sub-DPS.

equipment.name: 彻空的长吟
equipment.bonus: 2件套：重击伤害提高15%。5件套：重击时，有50%概率触发连发，再次造成50%重击伤害。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: Charged Attack DMG +15%. 5-piece: Charged Attacks have 50% chance to trigger repeat dealing 50% Charged Attack DMG.
equipment.description: 重击流角色专用，输出爆发力强。
equipment.descriptionEn: Specialized for Charged Attack builds, high burst potential.

equipment.name: 凝夜的披甲
equipment.bonus: 2件套：受到伤害降低15%。5件套：受到致命伤害时，保留1点生命值并恢复30%生命值，每120秒触发一次。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: DMG taken -15%. 5-piece: When receiving fatal damage, survive with 1 HP and restore 30% HP, triggers every 120s.
equipment.description: 生存套装，适合坦克和治疗角色。
equipment.descriptionEn: Survival set, suitable for tanks and healers.
